body.statement: As a direct application corollary of RenTelschowSchwartzman2024 to the simultaneous tube event, for every \(k\in\mathbb R\) at once, \(\mathcal C(k)\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(k)\) and \(\{W(\theta_c):c\in\mathcal C(k)\}\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal V}_n(k)\). The inclusions require neither injectivity nor a nonzero derivative of the displayed path.
body.justification: This direct inverse-set application is a reporting corollary: retaining all compatible preferences avoids an artificial branch choice when the estimated curve is locally flat or numerically folds.
body.gap: RenTelschowSchwartzman2024 already proves the eventwise inverse-set logic; this statement merely instantiates that result for the bivariate causal frontier and is not part of the novelty kernel.
body.consumer: A planner specifying an acceptable KL departure obtains every preference and welfare value compatible with that target.
body.proof_tex:
Work on the simultaneous tube event proved in
\(\mathrm{thm{:}postselection\mbox{-}tube}\).  Fix any real \(k\) and any
\(c\in\mathcal C(k)\).  By definition, \(K(\theta_c)=k\).  The divergence coordinate of the tube event gives
\[
 |\widehat K(\widehat\theta_c)-k|
 =|\widehat K(\widehat\theta_c)-K(\theta_c)|
 \leq s_K(c)(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}+\eta)/\sqrt n.
\]
Thus \(c\in\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(k)\), proving
\(\mathcal C(k)\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal C}_n(k)\).  The welfare coordinate of the same tube event gives
\[
 W(\theta_c)\in
 [\widehat W(\widehat\theta_c)-s_W(c)(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}+\eta)/\sqrt n,
  \widehat W(\widehat\theta_c)+s_W(c)(\widehat q_{1-\alpha}+\eta)/\sqrt n].
\]
Because the just-proved inclusion makes this interval one of those in the union defining \(\widehat{\mathcal V}_n(k)\), it follows that
\(W(\theta_c)\in\widehat{\mathcal V}_n(k)\).  The argument is pointwise algebra on a single event that already holds for all \(c\), so it holds for every \(k\in\mathbb R\) simultaneously.  No derivative of the path, division by such a derivative, injectivity, or branch selection was used; empty true sections are harmless.
